title: SPY daily refresh: the warning named its own escalation condition and nobody was reading

verdict.root_cause: the escalation nobody owned: the post-close job noticed the series was short, warned 'this is only a problem if it is still true tomorrow', and nothing in the system looks tomorrow
verdict.next_action: refresh before 09:32 ET or today's Calm phases refuse too; the bar exists at the provider now; the command writes production data and is left for the operator

premise_correction.brief_said: the scheduler logged the job as completed successfully
premise_correction.actually: it logged completed OK AND, on the next line, a WARNING naming the exact shortfall
log: 2026-08-26 14:20:00 INFO [SPY_REFRESH_PM] Starting: update_spy_csv after the close (2026-08-26)

2026-08-26 14:20:13 WARNING [SPY_REFRESH_PM] ran cleanly but the daily series still ends on 2026-08-25, not 2026-08-26 — the close for today was not available yet. Tomorrow's sessions ask for the last trading day BEFORE them, so this is only a problem if it is still true tomorrow.
premise_correction.clock_note: log timestamps are machine-local (Calgary). 14:20 MT = 16:20 ET.
premise_correction.scheduler_success_means: child exit 0 AND a coverage read of the file's last date — Stage 5ZL added the second half; before it, the job asserted coverage having checked nothing
premise_correction.previous_day_for_contrast: 2026-08-25 14:20:13 INFO [SPY_REFRESH_PM] OK — the daily series now covers 2026-08-25

status_wording.before: nothing — the freshness gate refused and reported freshness_allow=false
status_wording.plain_line: SPY daily file is missing 2026-08-26 — it ends on 2026-08-25. Sleeves that run before the 13:45 pre-flight (the overnight NKD window) will refuse on stale daily context until the refresh is re-run
status_wording.why: a second copy of 'which day is needed' can drift from the gate that actually refuses, and then status and the gate disagree about the same morning
status_wording.nkd_20260827_operational: PASS — 22/22 slots observed, all decided; the stale daily file is a separate fact about the inputs

defect_found_in_my_own_stage_5zx.what: the phased Calm slots never evaluated freshness
defect_found_in_my_own_stage_5zx.how_it_happened: Stage 5ZX put the phase's early exit before fresh.evaluate, bundling freshness with the cap guard and admission layer on the reasoning that a decide half takes no position
defect_found_in_my_own_stage_5zx.why_that_reasoning_is_wrong: freshness is not a statement about positions; it asks whether the INPUTS are current enough to decide on at all, which is as live for a half that records an intent as for one that books a trade
defect_found_in_my_own_stage_5zx.consequence_if_unfixed: the decide half would record an intent computed from a two-day-old regime label, in a row carrying no note that it was

now.detail: the inputs a decision needs are not current: regime_csv
now.classify_day: incomplete — the day does not count

todays_calm_is_affected.why: the 13:45 ET pre-flight runs AFTER both phases
todays_calm_is_affected.consequence: unless the series is refreshed before 09:32 ET, the first-ever run of the new phases records a refusal rather than an intent
todays_calm_is_affected.structural: it is not only the overnight sleeve that runs before its own pre-flight — Calm does too. Everything before 13:45 ET depends on the previous evening's post-close refresh having landed.

should_it_be_fatal.paper_readiness: no — the gate already refuses on its own, and a day that produced no evidence is simply not a judgeable day
should_it_be_fatal.dashboard_health: yes, visibly, as a stale daily-context warning separate from operational slot status — now done
should_it_be_fatal.next_morning_freshness: it already is, and correctly so; that is why the overnight window refused
should_it_be_fatal.the_post_close_job_itself: now non-zero, because that is the moment somebody can still act
